title: ANTMUX-X72: XYZ / Stereo-Z and Da'at Path Experimental Architecture
description: Reproducible software artifact documenting a 12-channel ordered Givens coupling, center-plus-residual representation, synchronized bilateral stereo-Z source using +theta/-theta, reversible Da'at center/differential processing, and bounded observation-only experiments for traversal, oscillator modes, conservative coupled-field propagation, discrete graph geometry, and path-capacity sampling. The artifact documents an experimental architecture and does not claim a new biological, religious, neurological, or physical law.
